info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Deployment Status API
info.description: The Product Deployment Status API allows users to check the current deployment status of specific banking products. This endpoint is critical for stakeholders, such as product managers and developers, who need to monitor deployment progress and ensure timely updates are communicated. By providing insights into the deployment process, this API facilitates better decision-making and resource allocation. Typical use cases include integration with dashboards and automated system monitoring tools to enhance operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific product deployment.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about a specified product deployment identified by its unique ID. Use this endpoint to gain insights into the deployment status, configuration, and other relevant details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about the specified product deployment. It requires relevant data in JSON format to identify the product deployment and any associated parameters.

200.description: The request was successful and the product deployment details are returned.
